t: Superior low odour styrene-free bonded anchor for general purpose use suitable for solid and hollow substrates. Suitable for use in non-cracked concrete. Expansion-free fixing for small spacings and edge distances. Suitable for repetitive use in confined spaces and can be used in water-filled holes (except sea water). Easy dosage thanks to patented self-opening system and use of manual standard sealant or electric gun. Suitable for use in hollow masonry structures when used with mesh sleeves. Ideal for fixing awnings, canopies, fireplaces, balconies, fire escapes, gratings, storage racking, gates and handrails. Suitable for multiple uses as partly used product can be reused after fitting new nozzle (2 nozzles supplied).
b: General Purpose Use in Solid & Hollow Substrates
